build_AporiaGuardrail: build an AporiaGuardrail instance with optional api_key and api_base for LLM call moderation
transform_messages: transform chat messages by normalizing unsupported roles to 'other' for Aporia AI validation
run_prepare_aporia_request: prepare an Aporia AI validation request dict with messages, response, and validation target
run_make_aporia_api_request: run an Aporia AI API request to validate messages or response and block on policy violation
test_async_moderation_hook: test the async moderation hook that runs Aporia AI guardrail during LLM call with message transformation
